page.layout: One title page, all centred: title block at top, woodcut device in the middle, printer's imprint with date below. Handwritten notes and a library stamp on the right are not printed text.
page.notes: The central woodcut device (a figure within an oval wreath of fruit and foliage, with a winged creature at the base) is an illustration, not text. Handwritten inscriptions on the right of the device ("Diuersi..." style script, and "Lignoidi" style script), the round library stamp, the pencilled "1" top right, the pencilled initials near the imprint, and the shelf mark "A: 4488630" at the foot are not printed text and are left out. A blue underline is under "IUNII" in the title and is not printed text. The first line reads "LIBRI" in spaced capitals; the GENESEΩS word has a stylised letter that I could not read with certainty, so it is marked [?]. The imprint date is printed in the old reversed-C form and is given as MDXCIV. Printed line "S.Theologiæ" keeps the æ ligature as printed.
